instruction: Implement allowlist.matches(path, patterns). Normalize a POSIX relative path: collapse repeated / and . components and resolve ..; reject paths that escape above root, begin /, or contain backslash with ValueError. Empty path denotes root. Patterns are valid nonempty relative slash-separated components without . or ..; * within a component matches any characters within that one component, and a whole component ** matches zero or more complete components. Patterns contain only ASCII letters, digits, period, underscore, hyphen, slash, and star; no ? or brackets. Matching is case sensitive. Return true iff any pattern matches the entire normalized path. Preserve patterns.
